high_level_description: This image is a screenshot of a Twitter feed displaying three tweets. The top tweet is an advertisement for ADIPEC 2025, which is a conference focused on artificial intelligence. The ad features a person in traditional Middle Eastern attire standing against a backdrop of futuristic technology and energy, with the text "Unlocking Artificial Intelligence" and "MAXIMIZING ENERGY, INTELLIGENCE AND IMPACT." The tweet has garnered significant engagement, with 433 likes, 9.3 million impressions, and 32 retweets. Below the advertisement, there is a tweet from a user named "awesome_visuals"
